description.text:
A high-class pack released on 2 December 2022 that brought back cards that did well in battle, such as Mew VMAX, Arceus VSTAR, Origin Forme Palkia VSTAR and Giratina VSTAR, with new cards: Regigigas VSTAR, Hatterene VMAX, Simisear VSTAR, Radiant Eternatus, which ends its player's turn to bring out up to two Pokémon VMAX from the deck, the Pokémon Tool Sky Seal Stone and the Supporters Friends in Sinnoh and Friends in Hisui, which show the Trainers of those regions together. Each pack held ten cards, one of them a Pokémon V, VSTAR or VMAX. The ordinary cards are numbered to 172. After them come 37 Art Rare and 35 Special Art Rare cards, full-art Super Rare Supporters and basic Energy, and gold Ultra Rare Origin Forme Palkia VSTAR, Origin Forme Dialga VSTAR, Giratina VSTAR and Arceus VSTAR. In English some of its cards came out in Crown Zenith in January 2023.

VSTAR Universe introduced two rarities, the Art Rare (AR) and the Special Art Rare (SAR), whose illustrations carry each illustrator's own style. An Art Rare shows an ordinary Pokémon in a full illustration, and a Special Art Rare a Pokémon V, VSTAR or VMAX or a Supporter in a full scene. Both carried on into the Scarlet & Violet series.
